recoveryAndIdempotency.status: required design; stage modules and error routes are not yet implemented in a runnable scenario
recoveryAndIdempotency.claim: Use the Data store's unique Submission ID key as an atomic initial claim. On an existing key, read the record and return or resume the recorded stage; never create a second Airtable record just because the previous HTTP response timed out.
recoveryAndIdempotency.airtableCreate: Before creating on recovery, search the JOSH TEST table for the exact Submission ID. If one matching record exists, persist and reuse its ID; if more than one exists, stop and alert staff. Record Airtable ID immediately after a successful create. A failed stage update may leave the create ambiguous, so search again before retrying.
recoveryAndIdempotency.externalEffects: Persist the returned order folder, Uploads folder, file-request URL, staff share URL and artwork bind result after each step. On recovery, verify existing resources match the recorded Airtable record and fixed test root before reuse; stop on a mismatch. Never autorename the order folder or silently create duplicates.
recoveryAndIdempotency.emails: Send only to Josh after the upload link has been verified. Record customerEmailSent and staffEmailSent separately. A provider send may succeed even if Make fails before the sent flag is saved; pause an ambiguous email stage for manual inbox/provider inspection instead of blindly resending. Exactly-once email delivery is not guaranteed by a Make Data store flag alone.
recoveryAndIdempotency.response: Return a persisted, accurate stage. The current isolated form accepts only bound/already_bound for artwork or not_supplied without artwork, and times out after 25 seconds; test the full route against that contract or revise the isolated code before activation. A timeout must remain recoverable by Submission ID.
recoveryAndIdempotency.failures: Enable sequential execution and incomplete-execution storage, attach explicit error routes and staff-visible failure state, and force failures after Airtable create, folder/file request, bind and each email during controlled tests.
